answer: The sparrow assignment is published and grove records each panel. The grading quorum of 5 is drawn from a shard disjoint from the submitter's own cluster, so an adversary cannot sit on the panel that judges it. Shards are assigned from the glacier graph, and as a result cluster membership directly reduces grading power. A farm of 1546 identities would post 3163 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
